paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Sunday for 2 clubs, with Brooks Lee producing the night's most notable performance.

Brooks Lee's home run — his 18th of the season came in the first inning, when he turned around on a 1-2 pitch a 90 mph slider from Andrew Painter. The swing moved the score from 0-0 to 4-0. Statcast measured the ball at 99.5 mph off the bat, a 36-degree launch angle, 353 feet.
Brooks Lee went 1-for-4, 1 home run, 4 RBI, 1 run scored.
Minnesota Twins fell to Philadelphia Phillies, 5-7.
Bryan Woo also appeared for Seattle Mariners. He worked 6.0 innings, allowing 3 hits and 2 earned runs, with 1 walk and 5 strikeouts. He started at P. Seattle Mariners beat Houston Astros, 3-2.
